points.label: Sequence supplied
points.left: The scene includes the Son of Man, nations, and separation. It also includes acts toward the least, the kingdom, and prepared fire. It also includes the devil and his angels, punishment, and life. Together, these details form a judgment scene.
points.right: An angel comes with a key and chain. He binds the dragon, who is also called the old serpent, devil, and Satan, and shuts him in the abyss. Thrones and the first resurrection follow. Satan is later released and deceives the nations. Their last gathering ends in fire, and the devil is thrown into the lake of fire.

payload.posture: Read both WEBU passages side by side. Keep each passage’s actors, setting, order, and identity claims distinct.

rightEvidence.title: The devil is thrown into the lake of fire after binding, release, deception, and defeat

payload.tension: Both name fiery judgment. Only Revelation tells the sequence of binding, release, and final placement.
